title: The Rogues (1998) DC New Year’s Evil February 1998 From The Pages Of The Flash
descriptionText: "The Rogues" is a comic book series published by DC Comics in 1998, featuring characters from the US Comics tradition. Specifically, the story takes place during the New Year's Evil February 1998 from the pages of "The Flash." As a collectible item within the world of comics and graphic novels, this issue offers fans a unique and entertaining addition to their collection, showcasing the dynamic characters and stories of the DC universe.
